ledger.claim: The deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. The GPS trace measures 29.98 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a booked optimal of 24.0 km, an excess of 5.98 km, which is 24.9% of optimal. Both limbs of the POL-RD-01 gate are passed: the excess is greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, and the platform's own derived facts record the deviation status as 'established'. The trace figure governs over the rounded 30.0 km carried on the trip record, which POL-RD-01 says may not be cited for the threshold test.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and has discharged it. Limb (a): trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00111 and the same pickup event at 07:47:40. Limb (b): the excess is measured from an unimpaired trace — 229 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. The burden therefore shifts to the driver to name a specific artifact and a specific clause; a general assertion that traffic was bad does not discharge it.

The driver cannot excuse the excess as a rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04. The only chat exchange on the record is the driver's own message — 'boss PIE towards tuas closed, lorry fire. i come off at bukit panjang ok', sent at 07:54:20, seven minutes after the trip had started — and the rider's reply 'as long as i reach by 8.30'. That is a passenger stating a deadline, not a rider instruction identifying a place or road, and that message's waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable.

The POL-RD-03 exoneration is not made out on the artifact the driver cites. Condition (c) requires the actual route to leave the optimal corridor before the affected segment AND to rejoin it after. The optimal corridor on this record is 'BKE southbound then PIE westbound'; the trace is described as leaving at Bukit Panjang and rejoining 'on the AYE' — a different expressway that the record nowhere identifies as part of, or as a reconnection to, the optimal corridor before the destination. Reaching one-north by the AYE does not establish the rejoin POL-RD-03(c) requires, and under POL-RD-08 an exculpatory clause is not discharged unless each of its conditions is made out on the cited artifacts. The measured excess therefore stands at 5.98 km unexcused.

No additional corroboration is required of the rider. POL-RD-08 raises the extra-corroboration bar only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more with 1 or fewer substantiated; here deviation_claims_60d is 1, so the condition does not engage and the trace alone carries the threshold. The profile is credibility weighting only under POL-GEN-01 and establishes nothing about this trip either way.

With the closure exoneration not made out, the refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 against the booked optimal route, not discretionary. charged_total is 37.74. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 24.0 km + 0.28 x 30.0 min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier recorded on the fare_breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, gives 31.00; there are no ERP, toll, surcharge, waiting-time or promo lines to add or subtract. Refund = 37.74 - 31.00 = 6.74, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, i.e. 6.75. That is 17.9% of charged_total, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND rather than a full one, and it sits above the 0.50 de minimis floor.

The optimal route the platform booked for this trip runs on the PIE westbound, and the LTA advisory on file, EV-ADVIS-00111-01, names exactly that corridor: 'Pan Island Expressway (PIE) towards Tuas, after Clementi Rd exit', with its geometry intersecting the route (intersects_route = true). That satisfies the first condition of POL-RD-03 — an advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses.

The advisory was active from 07:10 to 09:30 and its window overlaps the trip by 41.5 minutes; the vehicle was on the affected segment between 07:47 and 08:25, comfortably inside the validity window even before the 15-minute buffer POL-RD-03 allows at each end. The second condition of POL-RD-03 is met.

The GPS trace is unbroken — 100% coverage, 229 fixes at a 10-second interval, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0 — and it shows the vehicle leaving the optimal corridor at Bukit Panjang, before the closed segment between Clementi Rd and Jalan Anak Bukit, and rejoining it on the AYE afterwards. That is the matched diversion POL-RD-03 requires as its third condition.

The exoneration is capped, and the cap does not bite here: justified excess = min(measured 5.98 km, 1.30 x (29.2 km shortest lawful alternative - 24.0 km booked optimal) + 1.0 km tolerance = 7.76 km) = 5.98 km. The whole measured excess falls under the 7.76 km cap, so under POL-RD-03 the entire detour is exonerated and the closure-adjusted optimal distance is 24.0 + 5.98 = 29.98 km.

Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 29.98 km, not the rounded trip_record convenience copy of 30.0 km. Compared against the closure-adjusted optimal of 29.98 km, the excess remaining after POL-RD-03 is zero, so no deviation survives the adjustment and the threshold test has nothing left to measure.

Running POL-RD-02 against the closure-adjusted optimal route gives recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 29.98 + 0.28 x 37.5) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP and surcharges = 37.585 SGD, against a charged_total of 37.74 SGD. The residual refund is 0.155 SGD, below the SGD 0.50 de minimis, so the outcome is NO_ACTION and the present charge stands.

POL-RD-09(2) would still refund off-route ERP to the rider as a standalone pass-through correction even where POL-RD-03 exonerates the distance and time charges, but on this trip tolls_erp is 0.00 and erp_gantries is empty: neither the driven nor the optimal route crosses a gantry at this hour. There is nothing to correct and the exoneration is total.

No full-refund uplift is available on these facts. The deviation is not MATERIAL — 5.98 km is below the 8.0 km absolute test and 24.9% is below the 50% ratio test — and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 588 completed_trips_90d, so no repeat-deviation pattern is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-06.

The driver gave the rider contemporaneous notice in the in-app chat at 07:54, before the diversion, that the PIE towards Tuas was closed by a lorry fire and that he would come off at Bukit Panjang; the rider replied only 'as long as i reach by 8.30' and did not object. The rider's later assertion that he saw no closure cites no artifact and is contradicted by the LTA advisory, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight against the documented external cause.

The driver's lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter of 1 is context only under POL-GEN-01 and cannot be substituted for driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d, which is 0. Any adverse finding built on the lifetime counter rather than the trailing-90-day field this policy names is discarded.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver — this is the ruling on trip TRP-00111 (Woodlands to one-north, 3 Aug 2026). The fare of SGD 37.74 stands; no refund is due.

What the record shows. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00111) is unbroken — 229 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps — and measures 29.98 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff. The booked optimal route is 24.0 km, so the excess is 5.98 km, or 24.9%. That passes both POL-RD-01 tests and is a deviation, but it is not a material one (below the 8.0 km and 50% tests), so the driver-profile uplift in POL-RD-06 is not engaged (deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 588 completed trips) and no conduct referral arises. The rider's measurement of the deviation, and the shift of burden to the driver under POL-RD-08, are accepted.

The closure. LTA advisory EV-ADVIS-00111-01 records a vehicle fire closing all lanes of the PIE towards Tuas after the Clementi Rd exit, between Clementi Rd and Jalan Anak Bukit, from 07:10 to 09:30 — the corridor the booked route (BKE southbound then PIE westbound) uses (intersects_route = true) — and it overlaps the trip by 41.5 minutes. It recommends diversion via Upper Bukit Timah Rd, which is the route driven. POL-RD-03 is therefore made out: the advisory names the corridor, its window covers the trip, and the trace leaves the optimal corridor at Bukit Panjang before the closed segment and rejoins it after. The exoneration cap does not bite: 1.30 x (29.2 km shortest lawful alternative − 24.0 km optimal) + 1.0 km tolerance = 7.76 km, above the measured 5.98 km, so the whole excess is justified. The closure-adjusted optimal is 24.0 + 5.98 = 29.98 km over 37.5 minutes.

The rider's objection to the exoneration is not accepted. It argues the trace rejoins 'on the AYE' rather than the PIE, so condition (c) fails. But the route driven is the diversion the advisory itself recommends, and the platform's computed alternative (29.2 km) runs between the same booked endpoints; the leave-before-and-rejoin-after match the clause requires is present.

The money. With the excess fully exonerated no deviation survives POL-RD-01. Run for completeness under POL-RD-02 against the adjusted route: (3.80 base + 0.75 x 29.98 + 0.28 x 37.5) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown + 0.80 platform fee = 37.585, against the charged total of 37.74 — a difference of 0.155, below the 0.50 de minimis, so the outcome is NO_ACTION. The rider's POL-RD-02 claim of 6.74/6.75 is computed against the booked optimal, but POL-RD-03 requires the computation against the closure-adjusted optimal, which gives the de minimis result. There is no gantry or toll line to correct (tolls_erp is 0.00 and no ERP gantries lie on either route), so POL-RD-09 yields nothing, as the driver submits. POL-RD-04 is unavailable and changes nothing: the only chat messages are the driver's notice at 07:54 and the rider's reply, with waypoint_hint null, so there was no rider-requested detour. The rider's 'I did not see any closure' cites no artifact and carries no weight under POL-RD-08; the driver's contemporaneous chat notice is accepted. The driver's point that prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and context only under POL-GEN-01 is accepted; no finding here rests on reputation.

All artifacts carry weight 1.0, so no discount applies and confidence is not capped below 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
